records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Media!
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Created first project day 1 (fast start, Pro, active), but no key milestone and no invite in 6 days, and no reply to either outreach ([email:9f80d0a4], [email:91d7b814]). Zero tickets means no visible blocker but also no engagement signal. 8 days left; some chance they resume unaided.

draft.subject: Next step on your Maple Media project
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my last note -- now that your first project is set up in Wrenfield, the usual next step is getting work moving inside it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If you're bringing colleagues in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your setup and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Chidi
